shell.description: Use this page to introduce the counsellor, their credentials, and the kind of therapeutic relationship clients can expect.

intro.title: A calm, clear place to describe your practice
paragraphs: This starter copy is intentionally general. Replace it with your own professional bio, education, designations, populations served, and therapeutic approach.
You might describe how you help clients understand patterns, strengthen coping, process difficult experiences, and move toward choices that feel more aligned with their values.

values.title: Therapeutic approach
values.description: Update these blocks with the methodologies you actually use, such as person-centred therapy, somatic therapy, EMDR, ACT, CBT, EFT, narrative therapy, or another approach.

items.title: Collaborative care
items.description: Counselling works best when goals, pace, and focus are shaped together.

items.title: Respect for lived experience
items.description: Clients bring wisdom about their own lives, identities, relationships, and needs.

items.title: Practical support
items.description: Sessions can include reflection, skill-building, nervous system support, and next steps.
